purpose: Isolate frozen geometry/beta sensitivity without repeating same-range split-merge or P3 shared-state comparison.
calibration_inputs: ADXL samples corresponding to calibration frames
frozen target selection, angle, range and beta

test_only_factor.name: delta_theta_deg
test_only_factor.application: reproject test observations with frozen geometry plus the declared angle offset; no target refit

estimator_copy: truth and paper_response_metadata removed before estimation
outputs: frozen geometry hash and test-only perturbation probe
stop_conditions: truth appears in estimator input or output
frozen geometry hash changes under test-only ADC perturbation
non-finite output or undeclared target reassociation
claims_allowed: descriptive frozen-beta sensitivity under declared synthetic protocol
do_not_start_full_matrix_until: calibration-only route is selected and independently wired to the retained estimator path
seed mapping and provenance are resolved
strict calibration-only bias and initial-R initialization are specified
